name: UFLI Foundations
source: University of Florida Literacy Institute, UFLI Foundations (128-lesson K-2 scope & sequence)
licence_note: UFLI Foundations is a published curriculum (UFLI/Voyager Sopris); this file encodes only the public letter/pattern teaching order, reconstructed from memory of the publicly shared one-page scope & sequence chart — no lesson scripts, decodable text, or proprietary activities are included.
accuracy_note: Reconstructed from public scope & sequence; verify lesson numbers against the official UFLI chart before classroom use.
notes: Units are grouped clusters of lessons (label gives the approximate lesson range), not one unit per exact lesson — exact single-lesson boundaries are the part most likely to drift from the official chart; the ORDER of pattern groups is the faithful part. Blend units teach no new GPCs (existing single-letter GPCs are simply blended together), mirroring how Letters & Sounds Phase 4 works.

units.label: Lessons 25–26 – v, z
units.notes: Wraps up all 26 letters + short vowels (Unit 1 of the official chart).

units.label: Lessons 30–32 – Digraphs wh, ck, ng; -tch trigraph
units.notes: tch.ch is a trigraph not in app.js's GRAPHEMES table — see NEEDED_GPCS.md.

units.label: Lessons 33–36 – Initial l-blends (bl, cl, fl, gl, pl, sl)
units.notes: No new GPCs — blending already-taught single-letter GPCs, same principle as Letters & Sounds Phase 4.

units.label: Lessons 37–39 – Initial r-blends (br, cr, dr, fr, gr, pr, tr)
units.notes: No new GPCs.

units.label: Lessons 40–42 – Initial s-blends (sc, sk, sm, sn, sp, st, sw)
units.notes: No new GPCs.

units.label: Lessons 43–45 – Final blends (nd, nt, mp, ft, lt, lk, lp, sk, st)
units.notes: No new GPCs.

units.label: Lessons 46–47 – Glued sounds am, an
units.notes: Composite ids for the vowel+nasal chunk — see NEEDED_GPCS.md.

units.label: Lessons 48–50 – Glued sounds ang, ing, ong, ung
units.notes: Composite ids — see NEEDED_GPCS.md.

units.label: Lessons 51–52 – Glued sounds ank, ink, onk, unk
units.notes: Composite ids — see NEEDED_GPCS.md.

units.label: Lessons 53–55 – Silent e: a_e, i_e
units.notes: Split-digraph ids per data/README.md convention.

units.label: Lessons 56–58 – Silent e: o_e, u_e, e_e
Lessons 65–67 – Long o: oa, ow, oe
Lessons 68–70 – Long i: igh, y, ie
Lessons 83–85 – Variant vowel oo, ew, ui, ue
units.notes: ue is not in app.js's GRAPHEMES table — see NEEDED_GPCS.md.

units.label: Lessons 86–88 – Variant vowel au, aw, augh
units.notes: augh is not in app.js's GRAPHEMES table — see NEEDED_GPCS.md.

units.label: Lessons 89–91 – Soft c/g, dge, ge
units.notes: ge (as in cage) is not in app.js's GRAPHEMES table — see NEEDED_GPCS.md.

units.label: Lessons 92–94 – Silent letters kn, wr, gn, mb
units.notes: mb (comb, lamb) is not in app.js's GRAPHEMES table — see NEEDED_GPCS.md.

units.label: Lessons 95–97 – Suffixes -s / -es (plurals & 3rd person)
units.notes: es.iz is a composite id for the /ɪz/ ending (boxes) — see NEEDED_GPCS.md.

units.label: Lessons 98–100 – Suffix -ed (three sounds)
units.notes: Same ids as elc-bookmarks Level 8 — ed.ed = /ĕd/, phonemes ["e","d"].

units.label: Lessons 101–102 – Suffix -ing
units.notes: Reuses the glued-sound 'ing' GPC introduced earlier — same spelling/sound, new (inflectional) role.

units.label: Lessons 103–105 – Suffixes -er/-est, doubling & drop-e spelling rules
units.notes: est.est is a composite id for the /ɪst/ ending (fastest) — see NEEDED_GPCS.md. Doubling/drop-e are spelling RULES (belong in data/rules/rules.json), not GPCs, so they aren't listed here.

units.label: Lessons 106–108 – Schwa in unstressed syllables, -le syllable
units.notes: le.el is a composite id for the syllabic /əl/ ending (apple, table) — see NEEDED_GPCS.md.

units.label: Lessons 112–128 – Multisyllabic word review & advanced morphology
units.notes: Cumulative review + prefixes/suffixes/compound words — covered structurally by data/morphemes, not new GPCs.
